In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''' was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Grievous used the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] when he was attempting to [[Mission to suspected Confederate space/Legends|track]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] position in Confederate [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was in suspected Confederate space. [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] triggered the Grievous's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tracking beacon. This ship went into space, together with another ship. Anakin Skywalker was rescued, and the Vulture droids, who were the pursuit, finally exploded in the ship's engines.
